name: SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle for Bikini Bottom Deluxe
summary: Battle for Bikini Bottom Deluxe is a full game mod of Battle for Bikini Bottom created by Gravity. It is an expansion of the original Battle for Bikini Bottom featuring 200 Golden Spatulas, over 30 new areas, new collectables, Game Options, and so much more.
